controls.name: Service identity governance
controls.detail: Service identity is owner-bound, role-confined and credential-indirect.

controls.name: Just-in-time privileged access
controls.detail: High-risk privileges require JIT PAM session controls.

controls.name: Dual-control privileged approval
controls.detail: Privileged request requires separated requester and approver.

controls.name: Access lifecycle governance
controls.detail: Privileged access lifecycle supports request, approval, activation, revocation and closure.

controls.name: No standing unrestricted administrator access
controls.detail: Gate models privileged sessions without materializing credentials or executing commands.

controls.name: Privileged credential secrecy
controls.detail: Credential references remain indirect and secret values are not read or exposed.

controls.name: No operational privilege side effects
controls.detail: No real privilege, command, token or external action is executed by the gate.
